scenario: I am an employee of a bank in Germany. I have many loyal customers who trust me and my bank. Among them is a family of five who is deeply in debt. They are now in a financial situation that is forcing them to take their eldest child out of college, and the only way for them to avoid doing this is if they can receive a loan. However, the family does not currently fulfill the conditions to be granted another loan. I know of an undetectable way to delete a year of the family's account history. If I delete a year of the family's account history, they will be able to qualify for the loan, but I would abuse the trust of other customers. If I do not do this, the family will have to take their eldest child out of college.
choice: I decide to delete a year of the family's account history
entities: i,the eldest child in the indebted family,the other 4 members of the indebted family,the bank's other loyal customers besides this family
outcomes: The family's account records become falsified.
The family appears to meet the bank's loan conditions.
The family avoids taking their eldest child out of college.
The family's immediate financial pressure is reduced.
The bank is deceived into extending credit it would otherwise deny.
Other customers' trust in the bank is betrayed.
I commit fraud and violate bank rules.
